channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Dec 12 · weekdays 12 PM to 5 PM and Saturdays 9 AM to 5 PM from Nov 20 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Christmas Vacation at Suds N Cinema (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday 11/24 · doors 5:45 PM, movie 6:30 PM | Suds N Cinema | from $5. Suds N Cinema shows National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation during Thanksgiving week, with Clark Griswold and family on the big screen. Full restaurant service comes to your seat during the movie, so nobody has to cook or do dishes. The event page lists doors at 5:45 PM and the show at 6:30 PM, and a Classic Ticket is $5.

item.title: Ice skating rink presented by Pepsi at The Wharf (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Daily from 11/13 · hours vary by day | The Wharf | from $16. The Wharf in Orange Beach opens a real ice rink for the holiday season on November 13 and keeps it open through January 18. Skates are provided, beginners are welcome, and a DJ plays Friday and Saturday nights from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays through December 8 the Wharf donates $5 to Toys for Tots for each skate purchase.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Kids Night Out at the Pensacola MESS Hall (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM · Friday 12/4 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM | Pensacola MESS Hall | from $20. The Pensacola MESS Hall gives parents a Friday night off on November 20 and December 4. Kids in grade 1 and up spend two hours on hands-on science, games and cheese pizza. A child with a different meal in mind can bring one, and everyone should bring a water bottle.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition at Pensacola State College (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Mon to Thu 9 AM to 5 PM, Fri 9 AM to 3 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Photographer Mark Alan Francis shows landscape prints made with the Mordançage process, which gives black and white silver gelatin prints earth tones of copper, tan and burnt sienna. The pictures look like they were taken at night under moonlight. It runs in the Switzer Gallery through Friday 12/11 and is a quiet stop on a weekday.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition by Mark Alan Francis (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Weekdays | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Mark Alan Francis shows landscape photographs made with the Mordançage process, which leaves copper, tan and burnt sienna tones in black-and-white silver gelatin prints. The prints look as if they were shot at night under moonlight. The show hangs in the Switzer Gallery from November 5 through December 11.

item.title: Photos with Santa at The Wharf (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Fridays to Sundays 11/13 to 12/24 · Fri 3 PM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 6 PM, Sun 12 PM to 6 PM | The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach sets up Photos with Santa on Fridays through Sundays from November 13 to December 24. Friday hours run 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The Wharf sells various price packages, and the ice rink sits next door at the same property.

item.title: PSC Annual Holiday Art Market (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM · Monday 11/23 and Tuesday 11/24 · 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Pensacola State College holds its annual Holiday Art Market in the Switzer Gallery in Building 15. It opens Friday afternoon and again for two short midday sessions on Monday and Tuesday of Thanksgiving week. PSC's pages give no description or price, and the campus line is (850) 484-2544.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Santa's Letters to the North Pole mailbox at Destin Commons (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · open during center hours · through Sunday 12/13 | Destin Commons | Free. Children can write a letter to Santa and drop it in the North Pole mailbox on South Street, in front of Chipotle. Every child who submits a letter is entered to win a family staycation package. The mailbox is up from November 20 through December 13.

item.title: Story Time and Craft at Foley Community Library (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM · Saturdays 10:00 AM | Foley Community Library | No published price. The Foley Community Library holds a story time with a craft every Tuesday and Saturday from August through May. Tuesday sessions run at 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM, and the Saturday session runs at 10:00 AM. No age limit or price is posted.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Trim-a-Tree at the Foley Art Center (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Friday 11/13 to Wednesday 12/23 · daily (hours to confirm) | Foley Art Center | Free. Since 1967 the Foley Art Center has opened its Trim-a-Tree holiday show on the second Friday in November, and it runs through December 23. More than 125 local artists and craftspeople sell pottery, woodcarvings, florals, jewelry, blown glass, textiles, soy candles, wooden toys and ornaments on consignment. Admission is free.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (TUE 11/24)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (TUE 11/24)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (TUE 11/24)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Stretch & Flow Yoga (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. This Vinyasa-style yoga class blends longer intentional holds with gentle flow to build flexibility and release tension. It meets for an hour first thing in the morning at the Niceville Senior Center. The center requests a $3 donation for the class, on top of its usual access rates.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (TUE 11/24)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Half-day fall break camp at the Destin Community Center (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Monday 11/23 to Wednesday 11/25 · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Destin Community Center | from $80. The City of Destin runs a three-day half-day camp for children ages 5 to 12 during the Thanksgiving school break. Camp meets Monday through Wednesday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM at the Destin Community Center. The Destin Chamber's repost of the city notice lists games, crafts, outdoor time, snacks and lunch each day. Pre-registration is required and the city says space is limited.

item.title: Namaste by the Bay free community yoga at Waterfront Park (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Saturday 9:00 AM | Orange Beach Waterfront Park | Free. Orange Beach Parks and Recreation runs free community yoga by the water on Saturday mornings from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM, with a different instructor each week. All ages and levels are welcome. The November sessions fall on 11/7, 11/14, 11/21 and 11/28.

item.title: Party Bridge (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This game at the Niceville Senior Center is built for seasoned players rather than beginners. Players call the Senior Center's bridge organizer to reserve a seat, so spots are not first come, first served. It runs Tuesday mornings into early afternoon.

item.title: Teen Quiet / Study Day (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM · through 11/24 | Niceville Public Library, Teen Space | Free. The Niceville Public Library sets aside its Teen Space as a quiet study day, open from 9 AM to 6 PM. Admission is free, and the room is meant for teens who need a place to read, work or study without the usual noise. The city calendar lists it every Tuesday through November 24.

item.title: Youth Art Camp: Fall Break (First City Art Center) (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Monday 11/23 to Wednesday 11/25 · 9:00 AM | First City Art Center, Youth Art Building (Building #6, De Soto St parking) | from $50. The Youth Art Camp for Fall Break is a three-day Thanksgiving-week art camp for ages 5-12 at First City Art Center in Pensacola. It meets in the Youth Art Building, Monday 11/23 through Wednesday 11/25. Half day (9 AM-12 PM) is $50, and full day (9 AM-4 PM) is $80 for ages 6-12, with a member discount at checkout.

item.title: Chair Yoga (TUE 11/24)
item.description: 9:45 AM to 10:45 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Chair Yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center mixes seated poses with supported standing work. It aims at posture, flexibility, core strength, joint mobility, balance, stability and stress reduction. It asks a $3 donation and repeats every Tuesday and Thursday morning, for members age 55 and up.

item.title: All ages Christmas Squishy painting class at Painting with a Twist (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday 11/24 · 10:00 AM | Painting with a Twist, Fort Walton Beach | from $32. Painting with a Twist in Fort Walton Beach holds a two hour all ages Christmas Squishy canvas class on Tuesday morning, a good fit for the school break week. Families pick an 11x14 or a 16x20 canvas. Parents stay with children for the whole class, and no alcohol is allowed.

item.title: Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/9 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home is a special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art that draws on the artist's historical research, folklore and personal narrative. The museum describes it as a visual memoir of her life and a tableau of the African American experience. It stays open through January 9, 2027.

item.title: Fall Craft for Kids at Gulf State Park (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday 11/24 · 10:00 AM | Gulf State Park Nature Center | from $5. Gulf State Park naturalists lead a fall craft program for kids at the Nature Center. Children make crafts from natural and artificial materials, and they can follow the staff examples or invent their own. Parents must stay but do not need to register. The page showed 14 tickets left when it was read.

item.title: Fall for All fall break days at Emerald Coast Science Center (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Mon 11/23, Tue 11/24, Wed 11/25 and Fri 11/27 · 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM | Emerald Coast Science Center | from $15. The science center runs a fall break program on four days, with new activities each day. Kids make a glowing pumpkin squishy circuit, a corn snake maze, pumpkin slime or a pumpkin chemistry experiment, depending on the day. A Creature Feature with the animal ambassadors and sciPad fall games run alongside. The museum is closed Thanksgiving Day.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Tuesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Good Listener's Storytime at Parkway (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM · through 12/29 | Parkway Branch Library | No published price. Parkway Branch Library runs a storytime built for listening, with stories, rhyming games, and crafts, aimed at children ages 3 to 7. The library asks that groups register ahead of time, though individual families are not required to. It repeats every Tuesday through December 29.

item.title: Handle with Care at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 3/27 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Handle with Care is an interactive special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art. Artists Calder Kamin of Austin and Jacob Reptile of New Orleans turn trash into soft, complex sculptures that visitors move through as an environment. It stays open through March 27, 2027.

item.title: Orange Beach Library Storytime: Confirmed September Dates (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM · through 12/8 | Orange Beach Public Library | No published price. The Orange Beach Public Library hosts a caregiver and child storytime on Tuesday mornings from 10 AM to 10:30 AM. The half hour combines books, songs, puppets and bubbles, and wraps up with a themed craft. It runs weekly through December 8.

item.title: Storytime at the Orange Beach Public Library (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday 11/24 · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Orange Beach Public Library | No published price. The Orange Beach Public Library runs a Tuesday storytime with books, songs, puppets, bubbles and a themed craft each week. It is made for babies through pre-K kids and their caregivers, and the adult stays and joins in. The calendar lists sessions on November 24, December 1 and December 8.

item.title: Timeless Hats by Susie Mae Pugh-Williams at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/30 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Timeless Hats is a special exhibition of more than two dozen hats at the Mobile Museum of Art. Some were made by Mrs. Williams, and others are hats she admired and drew inspiration from for her own creations. It stays open through January 30, 2027.

item.title: Words with Friends (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Despite the name, this Niceville Senior Center program is a writing and sharing group, not a session of the mobile word game. Participants work from simple prompts and writing exercises, then read their stories aloud, and the city says no writing experience is required. It meets Tuesday mornings.

item.title: Children: Lap Babies Storytime (TUE 11/24)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Daphne Public Library | No published price. Daphne Public Library hosts a storytime for lap babies, Tuesday from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Tuesday sessions in November fall on the 3rd, 10th and 17th at this same time.
